criterion_text: Agent owner restart, stale/foreign mount, changing ordered lower identity, unmount failure and missing upper/work fail closed with no data loss; existing #3582 persisted records and legacy Workspace paths remain readable.

verifiers.summary: The Sandbox-owned Overlay manager preserves verified restart recovery, retains a failed legacy cleanup for retry, and fails closed for changed/foreign/missing/failed state without touching durable Workspace bytes

evidence.value: exact SHA 2041fb2ca9bc0f8403a17f23660af3a980b663e3 on Linux kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws: after moving physical ownership into nession-sandbox::mount::overlay, restart reattach preserved the durable upper; a changed lower, missing upper, symlinked work, foreign owner, competing mount, crashed owner and injected mount/unmount failure each failed closed without data loss; the last verified unmount released the lower and legacy durable paths stayed readable; a legacy record whose strict unmount failed kept its durable record and occupied directory, and a later retry completed the cleanup
